Title: Sr. Associate Commercial Performance Analytics

Conduct data quality assessments, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure the accuracy and consistency of analytical outputs. Translate analytical findings into clear, evidence-based summaries for review with PAI colleagues and brand-aligned stakeholders. Collaborate closely with US-based PAI colleagues and brand-aligned analytics leads to confirm requirements, clarify priorities, and deliver against agreed timelines. Support the standardization of commercial analytics and reporting processes by applying established best practices, tools, and documentation standards. Contribute to the adoption of new data sources, automation, and AI-assisted analytical tools to improve the efficiency of existing workflows. Communicate status, risks, and completion of deliverables clearly through email, meetings, and presentation materials, operating independently on well-defined tasks once proficient. Successful candidates typically have at least 3 years of experience in commercial analytics, data analytics, or reporting, ideally within pharma, healthcare, or another regulated industry. Working proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets. Working proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis, automation, or reporting workflows. Experience building or maintaining dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Professional written and verbal English sufficient for routine collaboration with U.S.-based teams, with the ability to ask clarifying questions, confirm requirements, and summarize outcomes accurately. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with patient, HCP, payer, or commercial pharmaceutical datasets. Exposure to statistical or machine learning techniques applied to business problems. Experience automating data pipelines or recurring analytics workflows. Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics or scripting tools. Experience supporting U.S.-based or global commercial teams from a near-shore or offshore operating model. Basic project management skills to help coordinate across data owners, PAI colleagues, and other stakeholders. Description: Location: Mexico City/MX or Toronto/CA Hybrid mode This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead a squad of data engineers and you also build things yourself. If your last few years have been spent in meetings about data rather than working with data, this isn't the right fit. What You Will Do: Lead a delivery squad. You'll run a pod of 4-8 data engineers (employees and contractors) assembled against a business outcome. You set the technical direction, decompose work, manage sprint-level execution, and are accountable for what the squad ships. When the initiative concludes or transitions to steady state, you and your engineers move to the next priority. Build with your hands. You write code. You build pipelines. You debug production issues. You're comfortable in SQL, Python, and Spark, and you use them regularly, not as a party trick, but as your primary tools. When something is broken or behind, you can step in and do the work, not just escalate it. Design before you build. You think in terms of data models, medallion architectures, ingestion contracts, and reusable patterns. You design solutions that are maintainable and that the next engineer can understand without an archaeology expedition. You care about schema evolution, data quality checks, idempotency, and lineage, not because someone told you to, but because you've been burned when those things were missing. Engage with the business. You're not building pipelines into a void. You'll work directly with Engagement Leads and business stakeholders to understand what they need, why they need it, and what "done" looks like. You translate business problems into data solutions and push back when what's being asked for doesn't make technical sense. You're comfortable in a room with non-technical leaders and can explain complexity without hiding behind jargon. Drive engineering standards. CI/CD, version control, testing, code review, documentation: these aren't aspirational for you, they're how you've always worked. You'll bring these practices to your squad and raise the bar for everyone around you. You care about developer experience and operational excellence, not just feature delivery. Operate on a modern stack. The platform is Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Spark, medallion architecture) running on AWS and Azure. You'll work with infrastructure-as-code, Git-based workflows, and pipeline orchestration tooling. If you've spent the last several years in the Databricks ecosystem, great. If you've built equivalent capabilities on other modern platforms and can ramp quickly, that works too. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long because we are obsessed with our customers . We get things done with urgency and focus , driven by extreme ownership over our impact. We collaborate without ego , fostering radical transparency and fierce loyalty so we can grow together. Because we aim for insanely great rather than just good enough, we stay insatiably curious —always experimenting, building the future today, and delivering a product that truly makes our users' lives better. About the role We are looking for someone to lead Lifecycle & CRM at Félix, build and manage the team, and own how we engage with users throughout their relationship with Félix. The role has three core mandates: grow LTV while effectively managing our incentives budget, generate customer insights, and identify opportunities to make Félix more relevant to our users . That means continuing to grow our core remittance business through activation, frequency, retention, and reactivation, while increasingly driving adoption of new products and expanding share of wallet. This person will also own the governance of our user touchpoints across WhatsApp, primarily post-transaction, email, and app push. User attention is limited real estate , so they will define clear rules around communication frequency, post-transaction messaging, channel selection, and prioritization, ensuring every communication has a clear objective and that the highest-value message reaches the right user at the right moment. They will build and continuously optimize a structured portfolio of lifecycle communications against each objective, rigorously measuring incrementality through control groups. They will also determine not only what we should communicate, but where it should live : what deserves a CRM touchpoint versus what should become part of the product experience, such as the chatbot or main menu. The role will work closely with Product, Growth, Brand, Data, Operations, and regional teams, turning CRM into both a measurable growth lever and one of Félix’s strongest sources of customer intelligence. Responsibilities Own the lifecycle strategy end to end , from signup and first transaction through repeat usage, activation, retention, reactivation, cross-sell, and long-term customer value. Grow LTV across the customer base , identifying the highest-leverage opportunities to increase transaction frequency, retention, product adoption, and share of wallet. Own the incentives strategy and budget , determining where incentives create true incremental behavior versus subsidizing activity that would have happened anyway. Build a rigorous experimentation engine across the lifecycle, using control groups, holdouts, segmentation, and incremental measurement to understand the true impact of campaigns and incentives. Build and manage the Lifecycle & CRM team , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, standards, and a roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes. Own Félix’s communication governance , defining how often we contact users, through which channels, for what purposes, and how competing messages are prioritized. Manage the portfolio of lifecycle communications across WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and other relevant channels, ensuring every touchpoint has a clear objective and measurable value. Develop increasingly sophisticated segmentation and personalization , using customer behavior, transaction history, lifecycle stage, geography, product usage, and other signals to make communications more relevant. Partner closely with Product to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience itself. Drive adoption of new products and use cases , helping Félix expand from remittances into a broader financial relationship with its users. Build a strong customer intelligence function in close partnership with the Data team , systematically extracting insights from behavioral data, campaign performance, customer conversations, research, and qualitative feedback. Turn customer insights into action , identifying unmet needs, friction points, new product opportunities, and ways Félix can become more useful and relevant in customers’ everyday financial lives. Create closed feedback loops across teams , ensuring insights from Lifecycle & CRM inform Product, Growth, Brand, Operations, and regional strategy. Build the reporting and operating framework for Lifecycle , making performance, experiments, learnings, and opportunities visible across the company. Requirements Strong experience leading Lifecycle, CRM, Retention, or Customer Growth in a consumer business, ideally with high transaction frequency or recurring usage. Strong business judgment , with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on expected customer impact, incremental value, cost, and scalability Proven track record driving incremental growth across activation, repeat usage, retention, reactivation, and cross-sell. Strong understanding of incrementality and experimentation , including control groups, holdouts, uplift measurement, and causal thinking. Experience managing incentives and promotional budgets , with the ability to distinguish true incremental behavior from subsidized activity. Deep expertise in segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle journey design across channels such as WhatsApp, email, push notifications, and in-product surfaces. Strong analytical mindset and experience working closely with Data teams to define audiences, measurement frameworks, customer insights, and opportunities. Experience identifying and driving multi-product adoption , including second-product conversion, cross-sell, and increasing products per active user. Strong understanding of churn, retention, and reactivation dynamics , with experience building programs to prevent churn and recover inactive users. Ability to turn behavioral data, campaign performance, customer research, and qualitative feedback into clear product and growth opportunities . Strong product judgment , with the ability to determine when a customer need should be addressed through CRM versus becoming part of the product experience. Experience building and managing high-performing teams , establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms, and a high bar for execution. Ability to work closely with Product, Growth, Data, Brand, and Operations , influencing priorities and turning customer insights into action. These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. Key Metrics Incremental Transactions Incremental Users Cost per Incremental User (CPiU) Cost per Incremental Transaction (CPiT) Transaction Volume / TPV Growth Retention & Reactivation Lift Share of Wallet Growth Customer LTV Incremental Multi-Product Users Multi-Product Adoption Rate (cross-selling) Incremental ROI on CRM & Incentives This Role Works Well If You… You think of Lifecycle & CRM as a growth and customer strategy function , not a campaign calendar or messaging operation. You are commercially minded and naturally prioritize based on incremental impact, economics, and scalability rather than activity or vanity metrics. You are obsessed with understanding what actually changes customer behavior , and you want to prove it through experimentation rather than correlation. You are comfortable asking “Would this have happened anyway?” before taking credit for a transaction, retained user, or successful promotion. You treat incentives as an investment , not just a marketing expense, and are disciplined about where and when Félix should spend to influence behavior. You combine strong analytical thinking with customer intuition , moving comfortably between cohorts, experiments, behavioral data, customer research, and qualitative feedback. You think beyond individual campaigns and build systems, journeys, and portfolios of interventions that compound over time. You believe user attention is scarce , and that sending fewer, more relevant messages can be more valuable than maximizing communication volume. You have strong product judgment and are comfortable deciding that the best CRM idea should actually become a product experience. You naturally look for opportunities to increase the depth of the customer relationship , from greater frequency and retention to new use cases, products, and share of wallet. You are comfortable operating with high ownership and ambiguity , building the team, processes, measurement frameworks, and operating model as Félix continues to scale. You enjoy working at the intersection of Growth, Product, Data, and Customer Insights , and can turn what you learn about customers into concrete actions across the company. Title: Research Executive
Description: YouGov is building its custom research capability across Latin America, with a regional research team based in Mexico City and serving clients across the region, particularly Mexico and Brazil. We are looking for a Research Executive to join that team and work closely with the Research Manager, our commercial teams and colleagues across YouGov. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone looking to build a career in market research and consumer insights while helping shape a growing regional capability across Latin America. As a Research Executive, you will support custom research projects end-to-end, from questionnaire development and fieldwork through data analysis, reporting and presentation, working across different clients, industries and LATAM markets. You will collaborate with experienced researchers and colleagues across Mexico, Brazil and the wider Americas organization, as well as YouGov’s global research, panel, operations, product and data teams. Along the way, you will develop experience using YouGov’s proprietary panels, syndicated products and other data assets alongside custom research, while helping ensure our work reflects both YouGov’s research standards and the language, culture and market realities of each country. This is an opportunity to join the capability at an early stage, with increasing responsibility as your skills and experience develop, while contributing ideas, sharing learnings and helping build better and more efficient ways of working across the region. We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical and comfortable working with data, with an interest not only in what the numbers say, but what they mean. Key Responsibilities Research and Analysis Support the design and delivery of custom research projects across Latin America. Help develop questionnaires, discussion guides and other research materials. Review questionnaires and research materials for accuracy, clarity, logic and consistency. Work with research and operations teams to help set up and monitor fieldwork. Check data carefully and identify potential quality issues or inconsistencies. Analyse quantitative survey data using appropriate research and analytical techniques. Review and help interpret qualitative findings where relevant. Conduct desk research and bring together information from different sources when required. Develop charts, tables and other outputs that communicate findings clearly. Look beyond simply reporting results to identify patterns, differences and potentially important findings in the data. Help turn research findings into clear conclusions and useful client-facing stories. Project Delivery Work closely with the Research Manager throughout the research process, from initial brief through final delivery. Help coordinate project timelines, deliverables and communication with internal teams. Work with YouGov's panel, operations and other research teams to ensure projects are delivered accurately and on time. Support multi-country studies involving different Latin American markets. Help coordinate translations and local-market adaptations of questionnaires and other research materials. Maintain high standards of accuracy and attention to detail across all project deliverables. Flag problems, inconsistencies or risks early rather than waiting until the end of a project. Clients and Commercial Support Support the Senior Research Lead and LATAM commercial team in preparing research proposals, presentations and client materials. Participate in client meetings and presentations as appropriate. Help prepare analysis and materials for client workshops and presentations. Develop the ability to explain research findings clearly to colleagues and clients. As experience grows, take responsibility for presenting sections of research findings and managing parts of client projects. Learn to understand the business question behind a research request rather than treating research as simply a data collection exercise. What We're Looking For Someone relatively early in their research career who has strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and the potential to develop into an excellent researcher. The Ideal Candidate Will Have Approximately 1–3 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, data analysis or a related field. Practical experience with quantitative research (questionnaires, survey data, analysis or reporting) Strong analytical skills and comfort working with numbers and data. Very strong attention to detail. The ability to distinguish between an interesting number and an insight that actually matters. Strong written and verbal communication skills. The ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across different countries, functions and levels of seniority. Fluency or strong professional proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese and English. We do not expect someone at this level to already know everything. We are looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, good judgment and a genuine desire to learn and grow . Experience in some of the following areas would be useful, but is not required: Brand, advertising or campaign research, including brand tracking and effectiveness studies Consumer segmentation, usage and attitude studies, concept or creative testing Customer experience, media, entertainment, sports or sponsorship research Quantitative data analysis, survey questionnaire development, data visualization and presentation Qualitative research, including focus groups, in-depth interviews or online qualitative methods Multi-country or cross-cultural research and experience working with online panels Exposure to syndicated, behavioral or other consumer data sources Why join YouGov? Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities. Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do. Life at YouGov We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do. We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.
